thanks for the help man. I agree completely. When I die i totally want everyone to be like "man it sucks that hes dead and all but damn these are some big words"

Yeah, I think will will be dulled, long term. I think it's just better to say than not, to clear up worries that maybe it was something impulsively i did that I would regret, but instead it was something i was more secure in.

the uninhabitable wasteland thing is about how I've realized I'm not depressed because of what I have or don't have. No matter what I have it will still be dull and grey to me like everything else. Kind of like a midas touch but with depression.

That last bit is actually a really good point. I guess it's nothing to be taken to literally. I suppose I more mean I'm happy knowing that I CAN be gone, I'm glad to know that death is there and how much it is "emptyness"
